* The base shim utilities class. * *

Subclasses (like ShimUtilsRAndS) are tied to specific Android SDK versions to provide SDK * specific behaviors. * *

Callers should call getInstance to get a correct version of ShimUtils object.

methods.name: public static ShimUtils getInstance()
methods.comment: Get a ShimUtils instance based on the platform version

methods.name: public abstract IkeException getWrappedIkeException(Exception exception)
methods.comment: * Wrap the Exception as an IkeException or do nothing if the input is already an IkeException.

methods.name: public abstract Exception getRetransmissionFailedException(String errMsg)
methods.comment: Create an Exception for a retransmission failure

methods.name: public abstract IOException getDnsFailedException(String errMsg)
methods.comment: Create an IOException for a DNS lookup failure

methods.comment: Handle network loss on an IkeSessionStateMachine without mobility

methods.comment:
* Handle all IkeConnectionController calls that are not initiated from the

public abstract boolean shouldSkipIfSameNetwork(boolean skipIfSameNetwork)

* Return if IkeConnectionController can skip a mobility update when the underlying network and

methods.comment: Returns if the device supports kernel migration without encap socket changes.
